hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let number be the numeric entry "turns_of_evil_scaffolding_drill_interval_phase_2" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let number2 be the numeric entry "turns_of_evil_scaffolding_drill_interval_phase_3" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Set the script register's 'turnsInPhase2Phase3' to if number is more than number2 then number else number2.
Call arg.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Count up "turnsInPhase2Phase3".
If condition flag "evil_scaffolding_drill_done" is up this frame, then reset the count "turnsInPhase2Phase3".
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the numeric entry arg in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is at most the count "turnsInPhase2Phase3", then the enemy uses the move labelled "evil_scaffolding_drill".
  Otherwise, the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
